_about: Public-domain Johannes Oecolampadius (1482-1531), the reformer of Basel, for the Word Hoard: A Sermon of Jhon Oecolampadius to yong men and maydens, in a Tudor English translation (catalogued 1548), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
